name: Masunaga Kazuna
source:
He always cares about those around him, and is a leader who is trusted by the other members. He has a lot of talent for singing and dancing and is an uncompromising perfectionist. 

The reason why he continues to work so hard seems to be related to the reason he became an idol...

[Translated from [url=http://www.bprogame.com/member/#masunagakazuna]official website[/url]]
